name: SM telemetry profile
purpose: Measured SuperMimic route performance, all active rewards, and useful environment diagnostics.
default_reduction: Use route-specific tracking when route labels exist. Retain one mean or RMS per concept. Do not generate routine percentile or maximum variants.

tracking_frames.hands: Calibrated palm points and orientations in each pose full hip frame.

reward_activation: Render all and only active signed episodic components from the actual run. Omit disabled or unavailable components.
curriculum: Omit this section for fixed H32. Active hand tolerances remain unchanged and can appear as measured scalars in Env. Show a Curriculum section only for an actual horizon curriculum.
media: Hidden until actual policy videos exist. No information table substitutes for video.
algorithm_specific: The SM actor is deterministic. Do not publish PPO entropy, KL, clip fraction, or fictitious encoder losses. Applied action boundary fraction remains a distinct controller-domain diagnostic.
diagnostics: Route curves describe actual training populations, not matched fixed-cohort encoder comparisons. Keep necessary detailed evidence in files.

configuration.Algorithm: World model and deterministic dual-route actor
configuration.Specifications: Read actual architecture, batch sizes, histories, data, source, horizon and budgets from the frozen run configuration.
configuration.Entropy: Unavailable for the deterministic actor. Fixed collector exploration noise is not learned policy entropy.
configuration.Stop condition: Preserve the user-authorized run target. This profile never imposes an elapsed-time limit.
configuration.Media: Disabled until actual videos are recorded.
configuration.Tables: Store specifications in configuration, not information panels.

workspace.bilateral_measurements: Separate left and right plots. Separate SMPL and robot route curves.

route_definitions.assignment: Collector human_route boolean captured before env.step. True selects SMPL, false selects robot.
route_definitions.returns: Mean undiscounted completed episodic return. Components use the identical completed episodes.
route_definitions.episode_lengths: Mean completed episode length, including failures and nonfailure clip/time endings.
route_definitions.failure: Imitation or controller failure among completed episodes.
route_definitions.timeout: Clip-end or episode-time-cap ending without failure among completed episodes.
route_definitions.tracking: Pooled means on the rotating deterministic nonterminal subset. Separate left and right calibrated palms.
route_definitions.palm_frame: Each pose full hip frame, meters and rotation-angle radians.
route_definitions.root_frame: World XY meters against the original clean retargeted reference.
route_definitions.exposure: Actual route-selected simulator transitions within the recorded window.
route_definitions.samples: Measured nonterminal tracking samples within the recorded window.
route_definitions.gradients: Mean parameter L2 gradient norm before ordinary clipping across actual policy updates.
route_definitions.action_rms: RMS of actual applied commands including collector exploration, across all components and transitions.
route_definitions.action_rate: Mean squared command difference summed across action dimensions per actual transition.
route_definitions.clipping: Fraction of applied command components at the action-domain boundary.
route_definitions.reset_coverage: Observed episode starts only. Effective bins equals one divided by the squared empirical bin-probability sum.
route_definitions.hand_tolerance: Current sqrt squared tolerances on the measured nonterminal clip sample. This is not a fixed evaluation threshold.
route_definitions.support_gate: Fraction of actual transitions selected by the clean-reference foot support classifier.
route_definitions.sampling_window: Recorded 25-update windows, with physical and learner clocks preserved.
route_definitions.comparison_limit: SMPL and robot training populations can differ in clips, lengths and difficulty. These are diagnostics, not matched encoder rankings.
route_definitions.entropy: Unavailable. The actor is deterministic. Fixed collector Gaussian noise does not define a learned policy entropy.
